turns.text: Hi a ticket was submitted this morning , never got a confirmation email or respond the ticket number is 866572 was the ticket submitted

Your ticket #866572 was successfully submitted this morning. Our team is working through requests in the order they're received.

Here's what to expect: if you're on a free membership, our team typically replies within four business days. If you're a Power subscriber, your question gets high priority and will be answered before free users.

**Check your email:** A confirmation email should have been sent to the address you provided when you submitted the ticket. If you don't see it, please check your spam or promotions folder, or search your inbox for "UTR Sports" — sometimes it lands there. You can reply directly to that confirmation email anytime to add information, and it goes straight onto your ticket.

If you still can't locate the confirmation email after checking those spots, let me know and I can help from there.
Yes it went to my spam, I got it
